outbreak_frequency: Recurrent outbreaks in same town: >1000 cases in 1993, >600 cases in 2005 (12-year gap); linked S. Typhi strains persisted, causing isolated cases in 2007 and 2009; gastroenteritis outbreaks recurred 2007/2009
endemicity: Parts of South Africa historically highly endemic, but national notifications have declined in recent years; some areas remain endemic where potable water is lacking, while disease is now uncommon in urbanized areas with water treatment
seasonality: 2005 outbreak peaked in September (cases rose late Aug, peaked Sept, declined by Oct)
notes: National typhoid notifications declining overall; recurrence driven by unresolved unsafe water supply; suspected carrier(s) may sustain inter-outbreak circulation over 12 years
